text:
maria: Heads-up — we're planning a KMS/keystore rotation + VPC egress tightening next Wed 02:00 UTC. This will flip the new keystore AK/SK and apply a more restrictive egress SG that denies 0.0.0.0/0 except approved proxies. Impact: new GPU nodes in the warm pool might fail decrypts or be unable to reach audit shipper. Need ops + security input on risk and a fallback plan.

ajay: Do we have a list of all endpoints the warm pool needs during join? curious about NAT vs privatelink needs.

maria: Minimal list — keystore endpoint (keystore.redwood.internal), kms regional endpoints, s3 audit ingest (s3://redwood-audit-ingest), and our telemetry proxy (tls://telemetry-east.red). I'll drop it in the runbook link in a sec.

leah: Cost note — if we route audit traffic through NATGW instead of privatelink we could see a spike in egress costs and NATGW QPS throttling during mass warmups. We saw a NATGW bill spike during last egress cutover.

maria: Right — that's the crux. Security wants to shrink attack surface by denying wider egress but that pushes traffic onto expensive paths or breaks joins.

Tom: Two quick options: 1) allowlist warm-pool subnets in the new SG for the rotation window, 2) provision a temporary privatelink for keystore+audit endpoints. Option 1 is fastest. Option 2 lowers egress cost but takes ~6h to wire.

ajay: Option 1 needs an explicit rollback plan. If we add allowlist, we should auto-remove it after warmup completes. Also need metrics to verify no join failures.

leah: Metrics we need: keystore decrypt success rate, keystore API 5xx, telemetry publish latency, and NATGW bytes/s. If NATGW bytes/s > X or cost delta > $Y then abort/rollback.

sre-oncall: Suggest automated canary: spin 5 new GPUs in a staging warm pool with tightened egress first, validate decrypt/s3 writes, then scale to remainder. If canary fails, auto-rollback SG change.

maria: Agree on canary. I'll update the change ticket with canary steps and rollback triggers. Also pinging @security for explicit OK on temporary allowlist window.

devops-bot: Deploy check: keystore-rotation-pr #482 merged to infra. CI passed. Note: terraform plan shows 2 new SG rules to be added.

ajay: Can we tighten the SG rules to only the keystore/kms IP ranges and the telemetry proxy? I don't want a wildcard allowlist.

maria: we'll scope to FQDNs where possible, but cloud SGs require CIDR — security will provide approved CIDR blocks. Proposed ephemeral rule snippet:```aws
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "warmpool_keystore_allow" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.11.0.0/24", "10.12.5.0/32"]
  description = "temporary allow for warm pool keystore/kms joins"
}
```

leah: Add audit-sampling toggle in the runbook: flip audit sampling to 10% during warmup to reduce egress. That buys us headroom if privatelink isn't ready.

Tom: If we lower sampling, we must mark the time window in our compliance logs and ensure retention policy notes it — security needs traceability of when sampling was enabled.

security (via DM): we'll approve a 2-hour allowlist window + audit sampling, provided the change is documented and the ephemeral rule auto-removed. Also we need a post-mortem if any node misses decrypt.

maria: OK plan summary: 1) schedule Wed 02:00 UTC 2) run small canary (5 GPUs) in tightened SG 3) if canary OK -> add ephemeral SG allowlist for remaining warm pool with precise CIDRs + enable 10% audit sampling 4) monitor keystore decrypt rate, telemetry latency, NATGW bytes and cost delta 5) automatic rollback/remove SG after 2h window or on alert 6) post-mortem if any failures.

ajay: +1. I'll add Grafana dashboards for the three metrics and an alert with Alertmanager that triggers rollback runbook.

sre-oncall: Also add a manual abort step for on-call if something looks off; auto-rollback is OK but human decision may be needed for cost vs availability tradeoffs.

maria: Thanks all — I'll post the updated change ticket and link to the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/keystore-rotation-egress-cutover. Please review before EOD today. :thumbsup:
